observed_failure.summary: cmd.exe received the quoted echo token as a literal command name after the probe used /s /c through the Codex sandbox wrapper. The evidence therefore does not establish a workspace write-policy failure.

interpretation.note: The sandbox identity was distinct, the temporary deny ACE applied successfully, the host retained canary access, and cleanup succeeded. The probe stopped before held-out read testing because its cmd.exe /s quote handling was unsuitable after Codex sandbox argv serialization. The corrected probe uses cmd.exe /d /c only.
